name: Sendagaya
tagline: Shinjuku in 4 minutes and Shibuya in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where JR East run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 4 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 32.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 22.9 m to 34.3 m, a difference of 11.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: オーケーストア 千駄ヶ谷店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京勤労者医療会代々木病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 仁圭会林外科病院, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local).
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥340,000 to ¥350,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Sendagaya. Kokuritsu-Kyogijo has the Toei Oedo Line, a different set from Sendagaya. To Roppongi, for instance, Kokuritsu-Kyogijo is 11 minutes quicker. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

Close enough to walk to from Sendagaya. Kita-Sando has the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, a different set from Sendagaya. To Shibuya, for instance, Kita-Sando is 9 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥20,000 more at Kita-Sando. On safety, Sendagaya comes out ahead.

notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
四谷角筈線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
